summary: First iteration full backend + frontend test for HistoNe DSS. 27/27 pytest backend tests passed (auth, pathways, criteria filter, patients, 6 pathway decision-engine outcomes, no_referral, own-only list, PDF, referrals + PATCH status, admin criteria PATCH w/ version bump, live-DB engine re-eval, metrics, admin users, RBAC 401/403). Frontend Playwright test verified Login (HistoNe brand + google-signin-btn), Dashboard 6 pathway-card-<id> + NOT YET CLINICALLY VALIDATED banner, /assessment/new form fields, run-assessment-btn -> /assessment/:id with outcome-label, /referrals with ref-status Selects (9 rows), /admin/criteria with 6 crit-tab-<pathway> + crit-save-<rule_key>. No critical issues found.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py CriterionUpdateIn PATCH: uses exclude_unset=True but then filters `v is not None`, which prevents legitimately setting threshold=None or clearing citations; acceptable but note the special-case for 'threshold'.
AuthContext skips /me when hash contains session_id — good. Consider handling storage cross-tab logout events.
seed_criteria only runs when count==0; adding new criteria after first-boot requires manual mongo intervention. Consider idempotent upsert-by-rule_key.
referrals endpoint reason uses matched_criteria[0] (highest urgency after sort); label is fine but no fallback ordering guarantee if multiple same-urgency.
test_credentials: Bearer test_session_provider_001 (provider, user_provider_test_001) and test_session_admin_001 (admin, user_admin_test_001) — seeded in MongoDB per /app/memory/test_credentials.md
seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_MRN_001 patient and multiple assessments/referrals; hc_personal_breast_young criterion is toggled active->false->true within a try/finally and threshold reverted 55->50.
context_for_next_testing_agent: backend_test.py under /app/backend/tests is a full regression suite. Frontend auth via localStorage.setItem('session_token', <token>) works for both provider and admin tokens (interceptor in src/lib/api.js). No mocks. LLM explanation is best-effort; do not assert on 'explanation' field content.
